name: Senator Mehr Stonehallow
summary: At Gol'Bolar Quarry, Senator Mehr Stonehallow has arrived at the front lines to face a trogg infestation. The Ironforge politician and Explorers' League member oversees its containment and calls on eager adventurers to cull the beasts before they overrun the quarry.

sections.title: A Politician in the Pits
sections.body: Senator Mehr Stonehallow has left Ironforge's Senate halls for Gol'Bolar Quarry. A dwarf devoted to governance and the Explorers' League's historical pursuits, he knows the dangers facing the realm. When Rockjaw troggs clawed up from deep rock, Stonehallow came to the mining pit himself. He believes debate alone cannot protect the workers. So he offers bounties to capable travelers who can drive back the aggressive troggs and reclaim the quarry.

faq.answer: Senator Mehr Stonehallow serves in Ironforge's Senate and belongs to the Explorers' League. He has come to Gol'Bolar Quarry to organize its defense.

faq.q: Why is a senator stationed at Gol'Bolar Quarry?
aliases: why is he at the quarry
faq.answer: Senator Mehr Stonehallow has come to Gol'Bolar Quarry to take charge of a crisis. Rockjaw troggs burrowed up from beneath the earth and invaded the mining site, threatening dwarven workers and valuable excavations. Stonehallow will not leave the problem to distant officials.

faq.q: What does Senator Stonehallow want adventurers to do?
faq.answer: Senator Mehr Stonehallow hires newly arrived adventurers to cull Rockjaw troggs in and around Gol'Bolar Quarry. Clearing the lower levels helps secure the excavation site and protect the remaining miners.

faq.q: What organization does Stonehallow belong to besides the Senate?
faq.answer: Mehr Stonehallow belongs to the Explorers' League as well as the Ironforge Senate. His interest in subterranean excavations helps explain why he ventured beyond the capital.

angles.text: For dwarves, a senator standing in quarry mud instead of drinking ale in Ironforge's High Seat shows the grit expected of their leaders.
Stonehallow offers young Alliance heroes a glimpse of dwarven leadership: protect working citizens by slaying monsters.
